text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Happy Meek and Trainer Kiryuin want<n>to train with
us, their role models and<n>rivals, for our mutual
benefit.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Specifically, Happy Meek has taken it<n>upon herself
to issue a challenge to<n>us.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Just as she says, I do believe it<n>would be beneficial
for<n><chrname> too. We eagerly agree to take them<n>on!
